tasks.title: Unicode-aware slug utility
tasks.prompt: Build a dependency-free ESM slug utility in src/slugify.mjs. Normalize Unicode, remove combining marks, collapse punctuation and whitespace to single hyphens, trim edges, support an optional maxLength without leaving a trailing hyphen, and export slugify. Add concise usage documentation.

commands: import('{repo}/src/slugify.mjs').then(({slugify})=>{const a=slugify('  Café Déjà Vu!  '); const b=slugify('alpha beta gamma',{maxLength:10}); if(a!=='cafe-deja-vu'||b!=='alpha-beta') process.exit(1)})

tasks.title: Deterministic TTL cache
tasks.prompt: Implement src/ttl-cache.mjs as a small dependency-free cache with get, set, has, delete, clear, and size. Inject the clock through the constructor for deterministic tests, expire entries lazily on reads, and ensure setting an existing key replaces its expiry. Reject negative TTL values.

tasks.title: Streaming CSV summary
tasks.prompt: Create src/csv-summary.mjs exporting summarizeCsv(text). Parse a header row and quoted comma fields, reject ragged rows, and return rowCount plus per-column counts of non-empty values. Keep the implementation dependency-free and preserve escaped double quotes inside quoted fields.

tasks.title: Token bucket rate limiter
tasks.prompt: Implement a deterministic token-bucket limiter in src/token-bucket.mjs. Constructor options are capacity, refillPerSecond, and an injected clock returning milliseconds. consume(count) must refill proportionally, never exceed capacity, reject non-positive counts, and return a boolean without sleeping.

tasks.title: Re-entrant event bus
tasks.prompt: Build src/event-bus.mjs with on, once, off, and emit. Listener removal or addition during emit must not corrupt the current delivery order, once listeners must run exactly once even under re-entrant emit, and one failing listener must not prevent later listeners; return collected errors.

tasks.title: Strict configuration validator
tasks.prompt: Create src/config.mjs exporting validateConfig(value). Validate a nested service configuration with name, positive integer port, mode enum development|production, optional string tags, and retry settings with maxAttempts and backoffMs. Return a deeply frozen normalized object and throw path-specific errors for unknown keys or invalid values.

tasks.title: Callback pipeline to Promise API
tasks.prompt: Refactor src/pipeline.mjs from callback-only composition to an async runPipeline(input, steps) API while retaining the existing callback export as a compatibility wrapper. Preserve step order, stop on the first error, reject non-functions, and do not invoke the final callback more than once.

initialFiles.src/pipeline.mjs: export function pipeline(input, steps, done){let i=0;function next(err,value){if(err)return done(err);const step=steps[i++];if(!step)return done(null,value);step(value,next)}next(null,input)}

commands: import('{repo}/src/pipeline.mjs').then(async m=>{const out=await m.runPipeline(2,[async x=>x+1,async x=>x*3]);if(out!==9)process.exit(1);await new Promise((res,rej)=>m.pipeline(1,[(x,n)=>n(null,x+1)],(e,v)=>e?rej(e):(v===2?res():rej(new Error('bad')))))})

tasks.title: Extract bounded retry policy
tasks.prompt: Refactor src/client.mjs so retry behavior is isolated in src/retry.mjs and injectable. Preserve public fetchJson(url, options), retry only explicitly retryable status codes or network errors, honor maxAttempts exactly, support deterministic sleep injection, and never retry AbortError.

initialFiles.src/client.mjs: export async function fetchJson(url){const r=await fetch(url);if(!r.ok)throw new Error(String(r.status));return r.json()}

commands: import('{repo}/src/retry.mjs').then(async m=>{let n=0;const out=await m.withRetry(async()=>{n++;if(n<3)throw Object.assign(new Error('x'),{retryable:true});return 7},{maxAttempts:3,sleep:async()=>{}});if(out!==7||n!==3)process.exit(1)})

tasks.title: Repair LRU eviction semantics
tasks.prompt: Fix src/lru.mjs without changing its public API. get must promote a key, set must replace existing values without growing size, capacity zero must be rejected, and eviction must remove the least recently used key rather than insertion order after reads.

tasks.title: Make reducer structurally immutable
tasks.prompt: Refactor src/reducer.mjs so every supported action returns immutable state without mutating the prior object or nested items. Preserve object identity for true no-op actions, reject malformed actions, and support add, update, and remove by id.

tasks.title: Harden root-confined path resolution
tasks.prompt: Refactor src/safe-path.mjs to export resolveInside(root, candidate). Canonicalize existing ancestors, reject absolute candidates, traversal, NUL bytes, and symlink escapes, while allowing a not-yet-created final file beneath a real in-root parent. Return an absolute path.

initialFiles.src/safe-path.mjs: import path from 'node:path';export function resolveInside(root,candidate){return path.join(root,candidate)}

commands: import fs from 'node:fs';import os from 'node:os';import path from 'node:path';import('{repo}/src/safe-path.mjs').then(({resolveInside})=>{const r=fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(),'safe-'));fs.mkdirSync(path.join(r,'sub'));const p=resolveInside(r,'sub/new.txt');if(!p.startsWith(r))process.exit(1);for(const x of ['../x','/tmp/x','a\0b']){let ok=false;try{resolveInside(r,x)}catch{ok=true}if(!ok)process.exit(2)}})

tasks.title: Correct asynchronous batch queue
tasks.prompt: Repair src/batch-queue.mjs. Multiple enqueue calls within the interval must share one flush, maxBatchSize must trigger immediate flush, a failed handler must reject only the affected batch promises, and the queue must remain usable afterward. Add close() that deterministically flushes pending work.

initialFiles.src/batch-queue.mjs: export class BatchQueue{constructor(handler){this.handler=handler;this.items=[]}enqueue(x){this.items.push(x);return Promise.resolve()}async flush(){const b=this.items;this.items=[];await this.handler(b)}}

commands: import('{repo}/src/batch-queue.mjs').then(async m=>{const batches=[];const Q=m.BatchQueue;const q=new Q(async b=>batches.push(b),{intervalMs:10000,maxBatchSize:2});const a=q.enqueue(1),b=q.enqueue(2);await Promise.all([a,b]);if(JSON.stringify(batches)!=='[[1,2]]')process.exit(1);await q.close()})

tasks.title: Decorator-aware command registry
tasks.prompt: Implement package registry with a @command(name) decorator, duplicate-name rejection, async and sync invocation through invoke(name, *args), and metadata preservation via functools.wraps. Nested helper functions and docstrings containing fake definitions must not be registered.

tasks.title: Immutable inventory domain model
tasks.prompt: Create inventory/model.py with frozen dataclasses Product and StockItem plus an Inventory service. Quantities and prices must be validated, stock adjustments must be atomic and reject negative resulting stock, total_value must use Decimal, and snapshots must not expose mutable internal state.

tasks.title: Cancellation-safe async retry
tasks.prompt: Implement retry.py with async retry(operation, policy, sleep=asyncio.sleep). Validate policy, apply bounded exponential backoff with a cap, support a predicate deciding retryability, preserve the final exception as-is, and never catch or retry asyncio.CancelledError.

commands:
import sys,asyncio;sys.path.insert(0,'{repo}');from retry import retry,RetryPolicy
async def main():
 n=0;delays=[]
 async def op():
  nonlocal n;n+=1
  if n<3: raise ValueError('x')
  return 9
 out=await retry(op,RetryPolicy(max_attempts=3,initial_delay=1,multiplier=2,max_delay=3),sleep=lambda d: delays.append(d) or asyncio.sleep(0))
 assert out==9 and delays==[1,2]
asyncio.run(main())

tasks.title: Nested transaction context manager
tasks.prompt: Implement transaction.py with a TransactionManager context manager supporting nested savepoints. Commit only the outermost successful transaction, roll back the correct level on exceptions, never suppress exceptions, and expose a deterministic event log for testing without requiring a database.

tasks.title: Bounded generic ring buffer
tasks.prompt: Implement include/ring_buffer.hpp as a C++20 fixed-capacity generic ring buffer. Reject zero capacity, provide push with overwrite=false behavior, pop, front, back, size, empty, full, and preserve object lifetime correctly for non-trivial move-only types.

tasks.title: Location-aware expression tokenizer
tasks.prompt: Implement include/tokenizer.hpp and src/tokenizer.cpp for identifiers, integers, + - * / parentheses, and end-of-input. Track one-based line and column, skip whitespace, reject unknown characters with a descriptive exception, and avoid reading past the input buffer.

initialFiles.main.cpp:
#include "include/tokenizer.hpp"
int main(){Tokenizer t("a + 12\n* b");auto x=t.all();return x.size()==6 && x[3].line==2 ? 0:1;}

tasks.title: Move-only RAII file handle
tasks.prompt: Create include/file_handle.hpp implementing a move-only RAII wrapper around std::FILE*. Support open, close, read, write, validity checks, move construction and move assignment, reject operations on a closed handle, and guarantee exactly-once close without throwing from the destructor.

tasks.title: Constexpr vector mathematics
tasks.prompt: Implement include/math/vector2.hpp in namespace kc::math. Provide constexpr arithmetic, dot, squared_length, equality, scalar multiplication in both orders, and safe normalized() returning std::optional for the zero vector. Keep the type trivially copyable.

tasks.title: Header/source statistics accumulator
tasks.prompt: Complete include/stats.hpp and src/stats.cpp with a numerically stable streaming accumulator. Track count, mean, population variance, min, and max; define behavior for empty input using std::optional; keep declarations in the header and non-template definitions in the source.

tasks.title: Thread-safe snapshot counter
tasks.prompt: Implement include/counter.hpp with a C++20 thread-safe named counter. increment(name, delta), value(name), and snapshot() must be race-free; negative deltas are allowed but integer overflow must be rejected. snapshot must return a stable copy without exposing locks or mutable internals.
